contact.title: Need help?
contact.description: If you need additional information about fuel prices, the LiveFuelMap service, subscriptions, API access, or related questions, contact the site administrator. The administrator can clarify information, explain how the service works, or provide the required data.

home.heroText: LiveFuelMap shows current prices, price changes, a station map, ratings, comments, and reports.
home.heroCardText: Fresh prices, reviews, station map, PDF/Excel reports.

sections.stationsSubtitle: Card scrolling, filters, rating, photos, comments, and operator website.
sections.calculatorSubtitle: The calculator automatically uses the latest price for the selected station and fuel type.
sections.analyticsSubtitle: Charts, comparisons, and price dynamics in a convenient format.
sections.commentsSubtitle: Reviews are visible to everyone; creating and editing is available to authorized users.
sections.mapSubtitle: Visual placement of operators across Kharkiv and the region.

subscriptions.ctaTitle: Receive fuel price updates by email
subscriptions.ctaText: Create a subscription, choose fuel, schedule, and delivery time. Messages will be sent to the confirmed email in your profile.

frequencyDescriptions.Immediate: The email is sent only when new data appears or a price changes.

frequencyDescriptions.Weekly: One weekly report at the selected time.
